svg.title: From a $7 Entry Product to a $57 Bundle
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-related-offer-price-path; chapter number: 6; title: From a $7 Entry Product to a $57 Bundle; subtitle: Related products expand the order; delivery must match what the buyer actually purchases.; caption: Maik Kleinert | Content-to-Conversion Systems describes a $7 entry product, a mini course reduced to $20, and another product reduced to $30, producing a $57 order.; assumptions note: Maik Kleinert's amounts are product prices and the reported combined order, not audience counts or conversion rates. The first three amounts are individual line items, not running subtotals. The final amount repeats at delivery.; note: Maik Kleinert checks whether a promotional DM was already sent and whether the person already purchased. Funnel Building Secrets recommends placing a test order through checkout and the additional offers.; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Entry product; value: 7; display: $7; conversion: Buyer conversion not reported; detail: Maik Kleinert identifies the entry product as the starting offer in the DM-connected product bundle.; label: Mini-course addition; value: 20; display: $20 add-on; conversion: Optional purchase; acceptance not reported; detail: Maik Kleinert describes reducing the mini course from $27 to $20.; label: Related product addition; value: 30; display: $30 add-on; conversion: Optional purchase; acceptance not reported; detail: Maik Kleinert describes reducing the other product from $47 to $30.; label: Combined order; value: 57; display: $57; conversion: Applies when all three products are bought; detail: Maik Kleinert reports that the combined purchase is $57 rather than the $7 entry purchase alone.; label: Purchased-product delivery; value: 57; display: $57 order, unchanged; conversion: Delivery checkpoint, not another charge; detail: Keep access tied to the purchased products. Funnel Building Secrets calls for a test order to confirm the purchase path works.

rect.title: label: Entry product; value: 7; display: $7; conversion: Buyer conversion not reported; detail: Maik Kleinert identifies the entry product as the starting offer in the DM-connected product bundle.
label: Mini-course addition; value: 20; display: $20 add-on; conversion: Optional purchase; acceptance not reported; detail: Maik Kleinert describes reducing the mini course from $27 to $20.
label: Related product addition; value: 30; display: $30 add-on; conversion: Optional purchase; acceptance not reported; detail: Maik Kleinert describes reducing the other product from $47 to $30.

label: Combined order; value: 57; display: $57; conversion: Applies when all three products are bought; detail: Maik Kleinert reports that the combined purchase is $57 rather than the $7 entry purchase alone.

label: Purchased-product delivery; value: 57; display: $57 order, unchanged; conversion: Delivery checkpoint, not another charge; detail: Keep access tied to the purchased products. Funnel Building Secrets calls for a test order to confirm the purchase path works.

text.title: Assumptions: Maik Kleinert's amounts are product prices and the reported combined order, not audience counts or conversion rates. The first three amounts are individual line items, not running subtotals. The final amount repeats at delivery.
